items.title: Section: Five Gateways of Decline Closed, Five Gateways of Skilful Means Open

items.zh: 謂有國王，於世所知柔和淳質、聰慧辯才、得理解脫、巧便無害、樂無害法，所有沙門、若婆羅門，不能數往禮敬諮詢：云何為善？云何不善？云何有罪？云何無罪？作何等業能致吉祥，遠離諸惡？設得聞已，亦不勗勵如說修行，不能時時惠施、樹福、受齋、學戒。如是名王專行放逸，不修法行。若有國王成就如是五衰損門，當知此王退失現法、後法義利。謂前四門退現法利，最後一門退後法利。云何名為王方便門？大王當知！王方便門略有五種。何等為五？一、善觀察攝受群臣；二、能以時行恩妙行；三、無放逸，專思機務；四、無放逸，善守府庫；五、無放逸，專修法行。云何名王能善觀察攝受群臣？謂有國王，於群臣等性能究察、能審究察、性能思擇、能審思擇，忠信、伎藝、智慧差別，攝為親侍。如是名王能善觀察攝受群臣。
items.en: A king who does not regularly approach ascetics or brahmins gentle, upright, wise, and eloquent, known throughout the world for skilful, harmless governance, to ask what is wholesome, what is unwholesome, what is blameworthy, what is blameless, and what deeds bring good fortune while avoiding evil, and who, even upon hearing such teaching, does not diligently practice it, not regularly giving charity, cultivating merit, observing the fasting days, or studying the precepts. This is called heedless indulgence, neglecting the practice of the Dharma. A king possessing these five gateways of decline forfeits both present and future benefit, the first four gateways costing present benefit, the last costing future benefit. What is called a king's gateway of skilful means? Great King, know that these are, in brief, of five kinds. What are the five? First, skilfully observing and taking in ministers. Second, rewarding them with kindness at the proper time. Third, freedom from heedlessness, attending diligently to affairs. Fourth, freedom from heedlessness, well guarding the treasury. Fifth, freedom from heedlessness, diligently practising the Dharma. What is called a king's skilfully observing and taking in ministers? A king who genuinely investigates his ministers' loyalty, skill, and wisdom before taking them as close attendants. This is called skilfully observing and taking in ministers.

items.title: Section: Ministers Who Give Everything Because They Were Truly Seen

items.zh: 云何名王能善以時行恩妙行？謂有國王，於諸群臣善觀察已，攝為親侍，加以寵愛，隨其度量厚賜爵祿、重賞勳庸，最機密處而相委任，數以軟言現相慰諭。彼於一時，王遇怨敵、惡友、軍陣，大怖畏事命難現前，即便罄竭，顯示忠信、伎藝、智慧。如是名王能善以時行恩妙行。云何名王無有放逸，專思機務？謂有國王，於應和好所作所成機務等事，能於時時獨處空閑，或與智者共正思惟、稱量、觀察和好方便。如是於應乖絕所作所成機務等事，於應惠施所作所成機務等事，於應軍陣所作所成機務等事，於應攝受大力朋黨所作所成機務等事，皆能時時獨處空閑，或與智者共正思惟、稱量、觀察乖絕方便，乃至攝受強黨方便。
items.en: What is called a king's rewarding with kindness at the proper time? A king who, having well observed his ministers, takes them into his confidence, favouring them, granting rich rank and reward proportionate to merit, entrusting sensitive matters, and constantly encouraging them with gentle words. When the king later meets an enemy, a bad friend, battle, or great danger to his own life, these ministers give everything, displaying their full loyalty, skill, and wisdom. This is called rewarding with kindness at the proper time. What is called a king's freedom from heedlessness, attending diligently to affairs? A king who, regarding matters calling for conciliation, regularly sets aside quiet time alone, or with the wise, to properly reflect on, weigh, and examine the means of conciliation; and likewise for matters calling for severance, for charity, for military deployment, and for drawing in powerful factions, always setting aside such time to properly reflect, weigh, and examine each in turn.

items.zh: 如是名王無有放逸，專思機務。

items.title: Section: Five Gateways of Skilful Means Complete — And Five Qualities Every King Truly Wants

items.zh: 云何名王無有放逸，善守府庫？謂有國王，廣營事業、巧營事業、善持事業、善觀事業，善禁王門、善禁宮門、善禁府庫，又於俳優、妓樂、笑弄、倡逸等所，不以非量而費財寶，亦不耽樂博弈戲等。如是名王無有放逸，善守府庫。云何名王無有放逸，專修法行？謂有國王，於世所知柔和淳質、聰慧辯才、得理解脫、巧便無害、樂無害法，所有沙門、若婆羅門，而能數往禮敬諮詢：云何為善？云何不善？何等有罪？何等無罪？作何等業能致吉祥，遠離諸惡？既得聞已，善能勗勵如說修行，亦能時時惠施、樹福、受齋、學戒。如是名王無有放逸，專修法行。若有國王成就如是五方便門，當知此王不退現法、後法義利。謂前四門不退現法所有義利，最後一門不退後法所有義利。云何名為王可愛法？大王當知！略有五種諸王可愛、可樂、可欣、可意之法。何等為五？一、世所敬愛，二、自在增上，三、能摧怨敵，四、善攝養身，五、能往善趣。
items.en: What is called a king's freedom from heedlessness, well guarding the treasury? A king broadly and skilfully managing state enterprise, maintaining and properly attending to it, securing the palace gate, the inner gate, and the treasury, and, even amid entertainers and performers, not squandering treasury wealth disproportionately, nor indulging in gambling and games. This is called well guarding the treasury. What is called a king's freedom from heedlessness, diligently practising the Dharma? A king who regularly approaches wise, gentle ascetics and brahmins, asking what is wholesome and unwholesome, blameworthy and blameless, and what brings good fortune, and who, upon hearing this, diligently practices accordingly, giving charity, cultivating merit, observing fasting days, and studying the precepts. This is called diligently practising the Dharma. A king possessing these five gateways of skilful means forfeits neither present nor future benefit, the first four securing present benefit, the last securing future benefit as well. What is called the qualities that make a king beloved? Great King, know that there are, in brief, five qualities beloved, delighted in, and satisfying to a king. What are the five? First, being respected and loved by the world. Second, ever-increasing sovereign authority. Third, being able to overcome one's enemies. Fourth, skilfully maintaining one's own bodily health. Fifth, being able to reach the fortunate destinies.

items.zh: 如是五種，是王可愛、可樂、可欣、可意之法。云何能引王可愛法？大王當知！略有五種能引諸王可愛之法。何等為五？

blocks.text: Each gate of decline has a matching gate of skilful means. Then: what every king really wants.

Each answers one gate of decline. Master Cháng Bǎi: the king who neglects Dharma practice loses the benefits of this life and the next. Good ministers are wise and eloquent, skilled and harmless in government.

Master Cháng Bǎi: truly seen and well treated, these ministers go all out, even giving their lives to save the king. They handle the five matters of state: alliances, separation of enemies, gifts, military deployment, and winning over powerful factions.

Five things: the love of the world, increasing mastery, defeating enemies, health, and a good rebirth. (Untranslated, 0641a19: "these five are what a king loves and delights in. How are they brought about? There are, in brief, five ways.")
"Ministers who give everything because they were truly seen." People give their best to those who recognise what they can do.

quiz.q: What are the five gateways of a king's skilful means?
options: noble lineage, autonomy, freedom from cruelty, mild anger, and generous kindness
being loved, increased mastery, defeating enemies, health, good destinies
observing ministers, timely kindness, attending to affairs, guarding the treasury, practising the Dharma
nurturing the world, heroism, expedient means, proper enjoyment, Dharma practice
quiz.why: Each gateway answers one gateway of decline. Option B comes from the ten virtues, C is the beloved qualities, and D is what draws them forth. All three lists look alike, so the question tests the outline of the sutra, as Master Cháng Bǎi's listing shows.

quiz.q: What does each gateway of decline cost, and what does Master Cháng Bǎi say of the fifth?
options: all five cost only present benefit, since a king's affairs do not touch future lives
the first four cost present benefit, and the fifth, neglecting the Dharma, brings decline in the next life
one present, four future
all five cost only future benefit
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: such a king loses present benefit and happiness as well as those of the next life; the last gateway, heedlessness that neglects Dharma practice, brings decline in the next life. So only Dharma practice reaches beyond this life.

quiz.q: What does §11's English omit from the description of these ascetics and brahmins?
options: 得理解脫 and 樂無害法 are left out, though "governance" has the lecture's support
nothing: these two phrases are from a commentary and rightly dropped, as the lecture does
it omits 沙門
it omits 婆羅門
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi spells out all the qualities: wise and eloquent, knowing the principle of liberation, skilled and harmless in aiding government, delighting in harmless good. The English drops 得理解脫 and 樂無害法, and §13 is briefer still.

quiz.q: With timely kindness, how do ministers act in danger, according to Master Cháng Bǎi?
options: they first protect themselves and decide on loyalty once things are clear, a wise caution
they demand higher rank
they urge surrender
they give their all, offering loyalty, skill, and wisdom, even sacrificing their lives to save the king
quiz.why: This reverses §9, where ministers hide their abilities. Master Cháng Bǎi: these ministers go all out, contributing everything, even giving their lives to save the king. The kindness shown beforehand is what makes this loyalty possible in danger.

quiz.q: 和好 is rendered "alliance." What is the problem, going by the lecture?
options: 和好 means making peace and friendly ties, so "alliance" blurs into drawing in powerful factions
none: 和好 is simply a military alliance, the same as the fifth item, as the lecture says
it should be "marriage"
it should be "trade"
quiz.why: The five matters are 和好, severance, charity, military deployment, and drawing in powerful factions. Master Cháng Bǎi glosses 和好 as cordial relations. It pairs with severance, while "alliance" fits better with the fifth, so the English blurs two items.

quiz.q: Which is not one of the five beloved qualities of a king?
options: being loved by the world, increasing mastery
defeating enemies, maintaining health
reaching the fortunate destinies
noble lineage
quiz.why: The five are love of the world, increasing mastery, defeating enemies, maintaining health, and reaching good destinies. Noble lineage belongs to the ten virtues. Master Cháng Bǎi: the fifth means reaching the good destinies of humans and gods in the next life.
